<?php
/**
 * Disposable-Playground helper for the docs screenshot harness ONLY.
 *
 * - Lets the server-side mf2 preview endpoint fetch this site's own
 *   loopback URL (wp_safe_remote_get blocks 127.0.0.1 by default).
 * - Drops the CSP upgrade-insecure-requests directive because the
 *   throwaway Playground serves plain http; the upgrade would break
 *   every same-origin fetch the composer makes.
 * - Relaxes the IndieAuth plugin's `me` validation so the flow can run
 *   against the Playground's ip:port origin (the plugin rejects IP
 *   hosts and ports, which every real site has no reason to relax).
 *
 * Never ship this outside the throwaway Playground instance.
 */
add_filter( 'http_request_host_is_external', '__return_true' );
add_filter(
	'outpost_csp',
	static function ( $csp ) {
		return array_values( array_diff( (array) $csp, array( 'upgrade-insecure-requests' ) ) );
	}
);
add_filter(
	'rest_endpoints',
	static function ( $endpoints ) {
		foreach ( $endpoints as $route => $handlers ) {
			if ( 0 !== strpos( $route, '/indieauth/1.0' ) || ! is_array( $handlers ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			foreach ( $handlers as $key => $handler ) {
				if ( ! is_array( $handler ) || empty( $handler['args']['me'] ) ) {
					continue;
				}
				$endpoints[ $route ][ $key ]['args']['me']['validate_callback'] = static function ( $value ) {
					return (bool) wp_parse_url( (string) $value, PHP_URL_HOST );
				};
			}
		}
		return $endpoints;
	},
	20
);

<?php
/**
 * Disposable-Playground helper: short-circuit core/plugin/theme update
 * checks. Playground's PHP cannot reliably reach api.wordpress.org, so
 * the checks block admin page loads while they retry. Screenshot runs
 * never need update data.
 *
 * Never ship this outside the throwaway Playground instance.
 */
$outpost_screenshot_no_updates = static function () {
	return (object) array(
		'last_checked' => time(),
		'response'     => array(),
		'translations' => array(),
	);
};
add_filter( 'pre_site_transient_update_core', $outpost_screenshot_no_updates );
add_filter( 'pre_site_transient_update_plugins', $outpost_screenshot_no_updates );
add_filter( 'pre_site_transient_update_themes', $outpost_screenshot_no_updates );
